svg.title: K24: No crash log. The app never ran.
svg.desc: The Deployment overrides the start command with pyhton, a typo of python. The runtime finds no such program, so the container never starts and there are no app logs.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: No crash log. The app never ran.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The runtime must find the program before there is any app to log

svg.text: Because the app never ran, kubectl logs is empty. The error belongs to the container runtime, not the app.
